text: AGP (Architectural Glass Products) says it is part of the Profile Group, New Zealand's window-and-door systems group. The New Zealand Companies Register lists Profile Group Limited with 2,250,000 of Architectural Glass Products Limited's 3,000,000 shares (75%).
short: AGP is 75% owned by Profile Group.
